mapper.select: SELECT FROM document WHERE parent_id = #{parentId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO document (document_id, document_kind, status, created_at, parent_id, check_due_date, document_name, document_type, submission_status) VALUES (#{documentId}, 'ACCIDENT', #{doc.status}, #{doc.createdAt}, #{parentId}, #{doc.checkDueDate}, #{doc.documentName}, #{doc.documentType}, #{doc.submissionStatus})
